obfuscation_indicators: adequate working capital to meet its needs
risk_summary: The disclosure is largely precise and well quantified, showing improved profitability, strong working capital, and full availability under its credit line. Key risks include declining Greenwood sales, operating losses in two segments, slower inventory turnover, and reliance on favorable product mix and new sales channels. Boilerplate caveats around estimates and materiality modestly limit transparency but do not dominate the excerpt.
